stories.title: DB migration for email verification
stories.acceptance_criteria: venues table has email_verified, verification_token_hash, verification_sent_at, is_founder, subscription_tier, admin_email. tythebarn seeded with founder flags.

stories.title: Founder rule for Tythe Barn
stories.acceptance_criteria: slug=tythebarn → is_founder=true, email_verified=true, subscription_tier=FOUNDER. Code comment present.

stories.title: EmailService with SMTP
stories.acceptance_criteria: sendVerificationEmail, resendVerificationEmail. Nodemailer SMTP. 3 retries, rate limit 5/hour, anti-enumeration.

stories.title: Secret Manager env vars
stories.acceptance_criteria: Code reads SMTP_*, EMAIL_FROM, APP_BASE_URL from env. Docs for Secret Manager setup.

stories.title: Signup flow with verification
stories.acceptance_criteria: Founder: skip email, mark verified. Else: token, hash, send email, email_verified=false. admin_email required.

stories.title: Verification endpoint
stories.acceptance_criteria: GET /verify-email?token=: constant-time compare, 24h expiry. Valid: verify, redirect. Invalid: error + resend.

stories.title: Verify pending and error pages
stories.acceptance_criteria: VerifyPendingPage, VerifyEmailPage (expired), ResendConfirmationPage. Match app theme.

stories.title: Audit logging events
stories.acceptance_criteria: Log: verification_email_sent, verification_email_failed, verification_success, verification_failed, resend_requested, founder_bypass_used.

stories.title: Test coverage
stories.acceptance_criteria: Tests: normal blocked until verified; founder never blocked; expired token; token reuse; dashboard blocked; resend rate limit; SMTP retry.

stories.title: Final verification
stories.acceptance_criteria: npm run build passes. Full flow works. Founder bypass works.
